description: Treet Battery Limited manufactures lead-acid batteries — automotive, maintenance-free, deep-cycle and gel types for vehicles, UPS and solar systems — and is extending into lithium batteries. Incorporated in 2019 as a subsidiary of the listed Treet Corporation Limited, it runs its head office at Kot Lakhpat in Lahore and a manufacturing facility at M-3 Industrial City, Faisalabad.
headOffice: 72B, Peco Road, Kot Lakhpat Industrial Area, Lahore 54770, Pakistan
